scope: Evidence-backed differentiators; no first/only or market-exclusivity claim. This index is navigation, not new execution evidence.

reproduce.expected: 5/5 links hold in text mode; inspect compiler, guard, payment and outcome sections in JSON

claims.title: Typed, reviewable owner policy
claims.claim: Owners express authority in a separate .x3 mandate that can be reviewed and hashed.
claims.evidence_level: local compilation + archived mainnet hash match
claims.limitation: Source hashes identify bytes; Guard does not compile or run .x3 on-chain.

claims.title: Checks outside the model
claims.claim: Compiler and deterministic mandate checks refuse unsafe programs even when a scripted model follows an attack.
claims.limitation: Scripted attacks are not proof of universal prompt-injection resistance or mainnet attack refusals.

claims.title: Policy checks on authenticated quote terms
claims.claim: Guard verifies the 1Click signature and checks quote terms against stored policy before authorizing a deposit address.
claims.evidence_level: archived NEAR mainnet acceptance + historical testnet controls
claims.limitation: Acceptance is not funding or settlement. The forbidden official quote control is a dry quote and also fails dry-quote checks.

claims.title: Source-to-payment traceability
claims.claim: One verifier follows source identity, compiled fields, Guard acceptance, executed transfers and recorded outcome.
claims.evidence_level: local verifier over archived mainnet evidence
claims.limitation: The owner manually funded; provider association is not cryptographic cross-chain atomicity; Guard does not authenticate outcome hashes.

claims.title: Restricted agent authority
claims.claim: The demonstrated signing key is limited to three Guard methods on x3lang.near.
claims.evidence_level: archived NEAR mainnet key and signer observations
claims.limitation: The agent account retains an owner FullAccess recovery key; this is not autonomous custody or control over the Solana funding wallet.

claims.title: Reproducible evidence with explicit boundaries
claims.claim: Judges can rerun local checks, inspect structured receipts and compare original source hashes.
claims.limitation: Offline replay does not refresh chain state, establish production reliability or constitute an independent security audit.

claims.title: Signed birth and constrained child delegation
claims.claim: Operator and parent signatures bind child identity and grants; SQLite transactions reserve budgets and enforce admission nonces.
claims.limitation: No OS isolation, public identity service or deployed chain custody. The host and database are trusted.

claims.title: Durable retirement and signed incident review
claims.claim: Local policy violations retire an agent across restart; signed majority findings can export an evidence-bound regression proposal.
claims.evidence_level: local SQLite and real Ed25519; scripted jury signing identities
claims.limitation: No independent AI judgment or automatic policy evolution. Local hash chains are not externally anchored; court cannot revive agents. External effects cannot be committed atomically with SQLite.

claims.title: Scoped vault complete-path execution
claims.claim: An archived real local NEAR Sandbox run executes an allowed payment, refuses bypass attempts, and checks revocation and owner recovery.
claims.evidence_level: archived real local NEAR Sandbox, not public chain
claims.limitation: Separate from invoice_06 and not a public-chain vault deployment. Owner FullAccess remains trusted. Archive tests do not rerun a node.

mainnet_vault_pilot.title: Owner-approved, agent-executed Solana vault payment
mainnet_vault_pilot.claim: On November 14, a dedicated Solana agent signed a policy-PDA-owned 5-USDC transfer for an owner-approved exact quote; 4.999746 USDC was paid to x3lang.near and the provider reported SUCCESS.
mainnet_vault_pilot.evidence_level: archived finalized mainnet RPC responses, one source RPC and one destination RPC; provider-reported linkage

reproduce.expected: archived_checks: passed; source_rpc_quorum and cryptographic_solver_causality remain false

mainnet_vault_pilot.limitation: A separate pilot from invoice_06, with no new NEAR Guard call. Operator-written .x3 checked quote terms off chain; the vault binds the exact owner-approved digest and transfer fields but does not verify the provider signature on chain. Owner recovery and upgrade authority remain trusted. The source quorum did not pass, and provider association is not cryptographic cross-chain causality or atomicity. The unchanged receipt has a disclosed request/program deadline mismatch; separate vault commitment and direct chain checks were used. One bounded pilot establishes neither production reliability, an external audit nor reproducible source-to-SBF build identity.
